prog='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set(); regs = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] == 0 and (i, j) not in seen:
                q = deque([(i, j)]); seen.add((i, j)); cells = []
                while q:
                    y, x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y, x))
                    for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                        if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == 0 and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny, nx)); q.append((ny, nx))
                regs.append(cells)
    regs.sort(key=len)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for y, x in regs[0]: out[y][x] = 7
    for y, x in regs[-1]: out[y][x] = 8
    return out
'''
